acceptedAnswer.text: Laloo is a website offering walking routes. These routes highlight locations of restrooms and drinking water sources along the way, to help you plan your journey.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find Laloo walking routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, Laloo provides walking routes in Zurich. There are two routes available for exploration in this city.

mainEntity.name: What are the themes of the Zurich walking routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Route 1 focuses on the old city and lake. Route 2 explores the Limmat River and the city hall area. Please note the original themes may have been in Turkish.
Route 1 is 2.11 kilometers long and takes approximately 26 minutes and 30 seconds to complete at a normal walking pace.
Route 2 is 2.676 kilometers long, and it typically takes around 33 minutes and 2 seconds to walk the entire route.

mainEntity.name: Are there any restroom or drinking water facilities along the routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Route 1 does not have any recorded restroom or drinking water points. Route 2 has drinking water points available along the route.

mainEntity.name: Does Laloo verify the accessibility of the stops on the routes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laloo does not verify the opening hours, fees, or accessibility of the stops included in the walking routes.
